Even (1,7) — one tile left — is unreachable. The nav helper plans a route but my body never moves.

This is a fundamental stuck state. Let me reconsider whether maybe the game requires the PLAYER to move and I'm supposed to be a passive observer, OR whether the notice board is a solid I'm trapped in.

Let me try reading the notice board by a different means — maybe there's a "read" that happens when I walk into it. Since I can't walk, let me try pressing E while facing the board's actual position. If the board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7), maybe the game's "facing" for a wall-mounted board on the north wall means I face up and the board is at (2,7) which is "north" of (2,8)... 

Actually — what if the board is at (2,7) but it's a wall-mounted board and the walkable tile is (2,8) or (2,6), and I'm actually at (2,7) which is the board's tile (a wall tile)? But the map shows (2,7) as '.' walkable.

Let me try a genuinely different idea: maybe the game has a "stuck" recovery where pressing E on the board (which I'm on) reads it. Let me try pressing E while facing DOWN and UP and LEFT and RIGHT in one sequence and look for any non-"nothing-there" event.
